components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action button. Solid Muted Teal fill, tactile press animation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font-family: 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 6px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease-in-out; outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.4; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action button. Transparent background with subtle border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground-dim); font-family: 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border); cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease-in-out; outline: none; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.4; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Translucent content container. Glass treatment with shadow-lift hover.
components.html:
Experiment Results

Mandelbrot set rendered at 4096x4096 in 12ms.
components.css: .ds-card { overflow: hidden; border-radius: 4px; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); background: oklch(from var(--surface-raised) l c h / 0.1); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px oklch(0.344 0.007 48.523 / 0.06); transition: box-shadow 200ms ease-in-out; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 12px oklch(0.344 0.007 48.523 / 0.08); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font', monospace; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--foreground); padding: 16px; } .ds-card-text { font-family: 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--foreground-muted); padding: 0 16px 16px; }

components.name: Badge Soft
components.description: Compact status indicator. Pill-shaped, 15% tinted background.
components.css: .ds-badge-soft { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 2px 10px; background: oklch(from var(--primary) l c h / 0.15); color: var(--primary); font-family: 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 9999px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; transition: color 150ms ease-in-out; }

components.name: Input Default
components.description: Text input. Transparent background, 1px border, glow-ring focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 4px 12px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--foreground); font-family: 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font', monospace; font-size: 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; outline: none; transition: all 200ms ease-in-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--foreground-dim); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--foreground-dim); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(from var(--foreground-dim) l c h / 0.15); } .ds-input:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.4; }

components.name: Sidebar Panel
components.description: Collapsible navigation panel. Solid surface, 300ms slide transition.
components.css: .ds-sidebar-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface-raised); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px oklch(0.344 0.007 48.523 / 0.06); transition: width 300ms ease-in-out, height 300ms ease-in-out; width: 280px; } .ds-sidebar-panel[data-state='closed'] { width: 0; } .ds-sidebar-content { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 16px; }

components.name: Control Panel
components.description: Floating dockable settings overlay. Glass treatment, responsive orientation.
components.css: .ds-control-panel { position: absolute; z-index: 40; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; background: oklch(from var(--surface) l c h / 0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); color: var(--foreground); border: 2px solid var(--primary); border-radius: 8px 0 0 8px; min-height: 0; transition: all 200ms ease-in-out; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px oklch(0.344 0.007 48.523 / 0.12); width: 40ch; } .ds-cp-header { padding: 12px 16px; font-family: 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--foreground-muted); } .ds-cp-content { padding: 20px; flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; } .ds-cp-section { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); padding-top: 16px; } .ds-cp-section:first-child { border-top: none; padding-top: 0; } .ds-cp-section summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding-bottom: 12px; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--foreground-muted); list-style: none; } .ds-cp-section summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-cp-section[open] summary { padding-bottom: 12px; } .ds-cp-section-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; padding-bottom: 12px; }

components.name: SciFi Card
components.description: Generative art card. Seeded SVG circuit art with snake-path animation.
components.html: Seed: 42
components.css: .ds-scifi-card { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid oklch(from var(--variant-color, var(--foreground-dim)) l c h / 0.2); background: oklch(from var(--variant-color, var(--foreground-dim)) l c h / 0.05); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); padding: 20px; transition: border-color 200ms ease-in-out; } .ds-scifi-card:hover { border-color: oklch(from var(--variant-color, var(--foreground-dim)) l c h / 0.95); } .ds-scifi-svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; opacity: 0.9; transition: opacity 200ms ease-in-out; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px var(--variant-color, var(--foreground-dim))); } .ds-scifi-card:hover .ds-scifi-svg { opacity: 1; } .ds-scifi-svg path { stroke: var(--variant-color, var(--foreground-dim)); stroke-width: 1; fill: none; stroke-dasharray: 1000 10; animation: ds-snake 60s linear infinite; } .ds-scifi-svg circle { fill: var(--variant-color, var(--foreground-dim)); animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-scifi-meta { position: absolute; bottom: 12px; left: 12px; font-family: 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font', monospace; font-size: 0.625rem; color: var(--foreground-dim); } @keyframes ds-snake { to { stroke-dashoffset: -1000; } }

narrative.overview:
This is a design system that breathes. Born from a Gruvbox-inspired palette and a developer's instinct to build their own tools, it treats the dark terminal as home and the glow of phosphor as punctuation. Every component is a node in a circuit — connected by shared color tokens, unified by a single variant source of truth, animated by the quiet pulse of generative art.

The aesthetic is earthy phosphor: warm, organic tones that feel like a vintage CRT's afterglow, applied with restraint. Depth comes from translucent glass layers and tonal surface stacking, never from heavy shadows or decorative gradients. Components respond physically to touch — buttons compress on press, cards lift on hover, inputs glow on focus. The system is monospace-first, not as a costume for 'technical' but because code, data, and measurement are the native language of this playground.

There is no corporate polish here, no Material Design handbook, no Apple HIG. The identity is earned through craft: 39 hand-drawn SVG icons, a generative sci-fi card system that produces unique circuit art per seed, a glow architecture that animates at 60fps through OKLCH channel manipulation. This is a living thing — it evolves, breaks, and rebuilds itself. The codebase is a garden, not a museum.
keyCharacteristics: Monospace-first typography (JetBrainsMono Nerd Font) — code-native, not decorative
OKLCH color space with split-channel design for JS-driven animation
Six-color variant system with a single source of truth (colorVariant.ts)
Translucent glass layers at carefully tiered opacities (5% → 10% → 15% → 80%)
Tactile micro-interactions: scale-press on buttons, shadow-lift on cards, glow-ring on inputs
Generative SVG art system with seeded PRNG and snake-path animations
Dark-first with a full light theme override

rules.name: The Opacity Ladder Rule
rules.body: Every non-solid surface uses the same hue at a different opacity tier: Hero at 5%, Card at 10%, Badge soft at 15%, Control Panel at 80%. This creates depth through translucency density, not through shadow or border.

rules.name: The Glow Budget Rule
rules.body: The glow system is an accent, not a texture. It appears on interactive elements at rest and intensifies on hover. Backgrounds, decorative elements, and large surfaces never glow — glow earns attention by being rare on any given viewport.

rules.name: The Monospace-First Rule
rules.body: JetBrainsMono is the default for every text element. A sans-serif display face is never introduced as a system default.

rules.name: The Two-Mechanism Rule
rules.body: Every elevated surface uses exactly one depth signal: either tonal progression (surface color change) or glass (backdrop-blur + opacity). Using both on the same element creates visual noise.

dos: Do use the six-color variant system from colorVariant.ts as the single source of truth for all component colors.
Do tier opacity carefully: Hero 5%, Card 10%, Badge 15%, Control Panel 80%. The ladder creates depth.
Do use clamp() for responsive typography — it scales fluidly without breakpoint jumps.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion — all animations and transitions must degrade gracefully.
Do use the cn() utility for class composition — it handles CVA output + consumer overrides via tailwind-merge.
Do keep components stateless — state belongs in hooks, not in component bodies.
donts: Don't use gradient text outside the Hero component. Emphasis elsewhere comes from weight or size.
Don't apply glow effects to backgrounds or large surfaces. Glow is earned by interactivity, not decoration.
Don't introduce shadows heavier than shadow-md in the dark theme. Tonal progression is the depth system.
Don't use useMemo or useCallback — the React 19 Compiler handles memoization. Write pure functions.
Don't nest cards inside cards. Cards are containers; nesting breaks the visual hierarchy.
Don't use monospace as a costume for 'technical' — this system uses it because code, data, and measurement are the native language.
